notes.title: WRAP HOUSE SIMULATOR | RADIO UPDATE
notes.content:
[p]Hello Wrappers!  

While working hard on the upcoming [b]Kitchen Disaster[/b] update (and many more big features to come), we realized the radio playlists were starting to feel a little... repetitive. So we decided it was time to spice things up and expand our playlist.

With this patch, the radio now comes with [b]channels[/b], each bringing its own vibe to match the way you want to wrap:

[/p][h2]📻 New Radio Channels[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Cloodroom FM[/b] – Chill lo-fi vibes, perfect for serving wraps at a relaxed pace.  
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Sunwave Radio[/b] – Mediterranean tunes that make the kitchen feel like a sunny coastal café.  [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Iron Wave Radio[/b] – Heavy riffs and pounding drums to fuel your grind with raw, unrelenting energy.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Neon Pulse Radio[/b] – High-energy synth beats for those rush hours when speed is everything.  
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Trapline FM[/b] – Trap tracks to keep your flow sharp and snappy.  
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Bosphorus FM[/b] – Local pop flavors to bring a colorful twist to your shift.  
[/p][/*][/list][p]
In total, we’ve added [b]45+ brand-new songs[/b] to keep the grill hot and the mood fresh!

[/p][h2]🔮 Coming Soon (Pre-Disaster Patch)[/h2][p]Here’s a quick look at what’s next, arriving before the big Disaster Patch:  
[/p][list][*][p] Online Orders system  
[/p][/*][*][p] Desserts  
[/p][/*][*][p] A Recycling Machine to grind and reuse leftover ingredients  
[/p][/*][*][p] Lobby browser with permission settings to prevent griefing  
[/p][/*][*][p] Voice Chat  
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Thanks for keeping the kitchen alive with your feedback and support.  
Stay tuned for the [b]Disaster Patch[/b], it’s going to shake things up in the best way possible.  

Stay saucy, Wrappers! 🥙✨[/p]

notes.title: WRAP HOUSE SIMULATOR — PATCH 1.07a
notes.content:
We didn’t want to make you wait any longer.  
Instead of holding everything back, we’ve split Patch 1.07 into two parts.  
This is Part One: [b]1.07a[/b] — focused on Cloud Saves, Networking, QoL improvements, and a brand-new Menu System.  
The second part, [b]1.07b[/b], is coming soon with even more surprises!

[h2]☁️ Cloud Save Support[/h2]  
It’s finally here.  
Your progress now syncs across devices — seamless, automatic, long overdue.

[h2]🌐 Networking Overhaul[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Trouble joining friends? Disconnects? Session not found?  
[*] We’ve rebuilt the multiplayer backend.  
[*] Fewer issues, smoother sync, better connection handling.  
[*] Lays groundwork for a proper Server Browser in the future.  
[/list]

[h2]🧺 New Ingredient Packs[/h2]  
Six new 20-serving prepped ingredients are now available at the market:  
[list]  
[*] 🍅 Sliced Tomato  
[*] 🧀 Sliced Cheddar  
[*] 🥣 Shredded Soft Cheese  
[*] 🥬 Chopped Lettuce  
[*] 🧅 Sliced Onion  
[*] 🥒 Sliced Pickle  
[/list]  
More expensive than usual, but worth it for high-volume workflows.

[h2]🧾 New Menu System[/h2]  
You can now disable items you don’t want to sell.  
[list]  
[*] Use the Menu Board at the counter or in the kitchen.  
[*] Helps simplify things for new players.  
[*] Prepares the system for future recipe expansions.  
[/list]

[h2]⚙️ Equipment Upgrades[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Increased upgrade effectiveness across most kitchen tools.  
[*] Tools feel stronger, faster.  
[*] (We’ll tune it further in 1.07b.)  
[/list]

[h2]🧩 Unlock Flow & Balancing[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Ingredient unlocks restructured to fit new additions.  
[*] Small price/curve adjustments.  
[*] Minor bugs fixed.  
[*] Janky object interactions smoothed.  
[*] General polish pass.  
[/list]

[h2]🔮 What’s Coming in 1.07b?[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 🛍️ A new shop — trays, ingredient containers, etc.  
[*] 🤖 Kitchen helpers (Kitchen Assistant? Auto Döner?)  
[*] ♻️ A system for reusing leftovers.  
[*] ✨ More surprises we don’t want to spoil yet!  
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with us. More to come — and we’re not going quiet again.

notes.title: 🎉 Content Expansion Update v1.06 Is Live! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hey [b]Wrappers[/b]! It's been a while. We know.

We've spent the last few weeks fully focused on building the most impactful update since launch and today, it's finally here.[/p][p]This update introduces a brand-new transport system, powerful new kitchen tools, fresh ingredients, and long-requested quality-of-life fixes.

From recipe expansion to core gameplay balancing, this patch marks a major step forward for [i][b]Wrap House Simulator[/b][/i][b].[/b][/p][p]Let’s dive in:


[b]🛒 New Feature: Trolley System[/b][/p][p]New means of transporting items has been the most requested tool since release day. A functional trolley has been added to help carry purchased ingredients more efficiently.[/p][p]Players can now transport multiple items at once.[/p][p][i]
[/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506132/f41ccbc9d8f6dc1e06c844ce04b006927d5b9874.gif"][/img]


[b]🥤 New Ingredients & Recipes [/b][i] 

[/i]– [b]2 New Cheeses[/b]: [i]Soft Cheese[/i] and [i]Cheddar[/i] both must be grated before use[/p][p]– [b]2 New Drinks[/b]: [i]Lemonade[/i] and [i]Orange Juice[/i] must be freshly squeezed with the new juicer[/p][p]– Singleplayer mode has been rebalanced to integrate these additions smoothly


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506132/8e281b98fce56b95dc48510666ec0b4818f0bc9a.gif"][/img]

[b]🔧 New Tools[/b][/p][p]Two brand-new kitchen tools have been introduced:[/p][p]– [b]Cheese Grater[/b]: Required to prepare the new cheese ingredients[/p][p]– [b]Heavy-Duty Juicer[/b]: Used to freshly squeeze fruits into beverages
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506132/bd8f1b825cdf2f9130e1c56b4f3b7ce611d5ac0f.gif"][/img]
   
[b]🛠️ Quality of Life & Balance Changes[/b][/p][p]– Dog barking volume now decreases with distance[/p][p]– Lettuce now provides 5 portions (was 4)[/p][p]– XP gain curve adjusted for smoother progression[/p][p]– Minor performance optimizations implemented[/p][p]– Network performance updated under the hood for better multiplayer stability[/p][p]– Preventative measures added for item disappearances[/p][p]– Corrupted save files now auto-recover after one in-game day


We're just getting started. More follow up updates are in the works and this time, you won’t be waiting in silence.[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Wrap House Simulator v1.05 Is Live! 🎉
notes.content:
A small but impactful patch is here. Some QoL improvements, some bug fixes. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]🆕 Features & Fixes[/h2]

[b]🆘 Unstuck Item Button[/b]  
You can now use this button to drop items stuck in your hand during sudden lag spikes.  
The networking system is still evolving, but this quick fix should be a lifesaver for now.

[b]🐶 Dog Can Now Be Fed[/b]  
There’s a new doghouse just outside the shop.  
Grab the food and go feed the good boy.

[b]🎹 Keyboard Detection Bug Fixed[/b]  
Sometimes the keyboard was misdetected, breaking keybindings and player movement.  
This has now been fixed.

[b]🥶 Drinks Stay Cold Now[/b]  
When loading a save file, drinks in the fridge will now stay cold.  
Previously, their temperature was resetting—now resolved.

[b]🎥 Missing Tutorial Videos Added[/b]  
Missing tutorial videos have been added to the in-game computer.  
Clearer guidance for new players.

[b]🧠 Waiter UX Update[/b]  
If there's no waiter hired, the “Press E to command waiter” prompt won’t show up when placing a receipt on a tray.

[b]🧊 Visual Noise Fixed in Large Fridge[/b]  
Some visual glitches inside the fridge have been smoothed out.

[b]💰 Money Balance Adjustments[/b]  
Minor but meaningful changes have been made to the in-game economy.

[h2]⚠️ Known Issues[/h2]  
We’re aware that some players are having trouble connecting to each other in co-op. We're working on a proper fix.  
In the meantime, please try the following:

[list]
[*]Close Steam completely, and disable any VPN you might be using.
[*]If possible, restart your router (optional but recommended).
[*]Log back into Steam, go to Steam Settings → Downloads → Download Region and make sure you and your friends have the same server selected.
[*]Verify the integrity of the game files.
[*]Launch the game and try again.
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉 Wrap House Simulator v1.03 Is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
Your feedback keeps the grill hot, and we’re back with another update focused on performance, balance, and some long-requested management improvements!

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]

[b]🛠️ Network Optimization[/b]  
We’ve increased bandwidth limits and tick rate for multiplayer sessions.  
This should result in less desync and smoother object syncing especially for players with slower connections.

[b]👷‍♂️ Fire Your Workers[/b]  
You can now fire employees directly from the tablet!  
[list]
[*]If you fire someone, you’ll need to pay again to rehire them.
[*]Want to disable them without spending money? Just set their Work Speed to 0 instead it works like a free toggle.
[/list]

[b]⏱️ Cashier Speed Fix[/b]  
The cashier felt broken to many players because their default speed was super slow.  
[list]
[*]Now they serve customers every 6 seconds instead of 20.
[*]You can still adjust their work speed from 1–40 seconds using the slider.
Should feel much more responsive now!
[/list]  

[b]📦 Order Generation Rebalancing[/b]  
We’ve reworked how orders appear in both modes:  
[list]
[*]In Singleplayer, later levels now offer a smoother progression curve.
[*]In Multiplayer, order pacing is more balanced to match the number of active players.
[/list]

[b]😇 Fairer Patience System[/b]  
Customer patience is now smarter and fairer:  
[list]
[*]Early levels give you more breathing room
[*]Later levels scale patience to match the increasing order complexity
[/list]

[b]🖥️ DX11 Launch Option[/b]  
We’ve added a new ""Launch with DirectX11"" option when starting the game.  
[list]
[*]If your graphics card has trouble with DX12, now you can use DX11.
[*]Much smoother experience on older or integrated GPUs.
[/list]

[h2]✅ Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]

[b]💡 Highlighting Bug Fixes[/b]  
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some screens or objects stayed highlighted when they shouldn’t
[*]No more blinking distractions!
[/list]

[b]🧂 Singleplayer Money Buff[/b]  
[list]
[*]We’ve increased money gain in Singleplayer Mode to make solo play more rewarding.
[*]Treat yourself you’re doing all the work, after all 💰
[/list]

[h2]🚧 Known Issues We’re Working On[/h2]

[list]
[*]In some cases, movement keys get mixed up – keyboard detection doesn’t always work properly (especially after device/controller switches)
[*]Optimization is ongoing we're continuing to improve overall performance for all hardware levels
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉 Wrap House Simulator v1.02 Is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello, Wrappers!  
Thanks to your amazing feedback, we’ve cooked up a fresh update packed with quality-of-life improvements, polish, and some highly requested features.

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]

[b]🎮 Singleplayer Mode[/b]  
A brand new mode for those who want to manage the wrap empire solo!  
[list]
[*]Staff is cheaper
[*]Upgrades cost less
[*]Customers are more balanced
[*]Patience times adjusted for solo play
[/list]  
[i]❗ Note: You can’t invite friends while in Singleplayer Mode.[/i]

[b]⏸️ Pause in Solo[/b]  
Whether you’re in regular solo or Singleplayer Mode, you can now hit ESC to pause the game anytime. Take five, wrap boss. 🛑

[b]🐱 You Can Pet the Cat[/b]  
Yup. It’s official. You can now pet the cat. 🐈❤️

[b]🍖 Cat Bowl Accepts Döner Paddle[/b]  
Feeding your furry companion with a döner paddle? Totally valid now.

[h2]✅ Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]

[b]🎨 UI Visual Improvements[/b]  
[list]
[*]Floating numbers are now rounded
[*]Various small UI polish to improve visual clarity
[/list]

[b]🧂 Sauce Containers Now Save Properly[/b]  
Sauce containers will now retain their contents between sessions. No more mysteriously empty bottles!

[b]🧠 Improved Waiter AI[/b]  
Waiters no longer break after table upgrades. They’re finally behaving like professionals. Almost.

[b]🌐 Network Fixes[/b]  
[list]
[*]Items no longer hover mid-air or sync incorrectly
[*]Backend network optimization for smoother sessions
[/list]

[h2]🚧 Known Issues We’re Working On[/h2]

[list]
[*]In some cases, movement keys get mixed up – keyboard detection doesn't always work properly (especially after switching devices or controllers)
[*]General optimization is ongoing – we’re continuously improving performance, especially for lower-end systems
[/list]

Thanks again for all your support!  
We’re actively working on more improvements and we’re just getting started.  
Stay saucy, wrap lovers! 🌯🔥

notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Patch – Multiplayer Fixes, Save Bug, QoL & Performance
notes.content:
We’ve released a new update focused on squashing bugs, improving multiplayer reliability, and adding some quality-of-life enhancements!

[h2]Multiplayer Improvements[/h2]

Identified and resolved two major connection issues:
[list]
[*]⚠️ A warning now appears if you're trying to connect between different versions (Demo vs Prologue).
[*]🔢 Session codes are now digit-based, fixing compatibility issues for non-Latin keyboards.
[*]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Added a new option in the Pause Menu → Invite Friends so you can directly invite your Steam friends into your session.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]🧾 Fixed: Wrap tagging UI was invisible – this has now been restored.
[*]🍽️ Fixed: Tables and trays that glitched out and became unusable until the next in-game day.
[*]💾 Fixed: A save system issue where trays would disappear after loading a saved game.
[*]🗑️ Fixed: Customers no longer accept trash or unwrapped wraps as valid orders.
[*]🎧 Fixed: You’ll no longer hear your friends' pickup/drop sounds from across the entire map.
[/list]

[h2]QoL & Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]⌨️ Added support for AZERTY keyboards.
[*]📈 Rebalanced XP progression – early levels should feel less rushed now.
[*]🖼️ General graphical and UI improvements.
[/list]

[h2][b]CROUCHING IS HERE![/b][/h2]
🧎‍♂️You can now crouch in-game by pressing [b]CTRL[/b] to better access lower fridge shelves and tight spots.

No more awkward jumping or fridge fumbles! 👀

[h2]Customer Feedback System[/h2]
Customers now give auditory feedback depending on how you treat them:
[list]
[*]✅ Correct orders
[*]❌ Wrong orders
[*]⚡ Fast service
[/list]

Please continue using the in-game feedback tool [b](F8)[/b] or [b](Insert)[/b] to report bugs and suggestions – it helps us much more than reporting in #feedback!

Thanks for playing and supporting us! ❤️

notes.title: 🔥 The heat is rising… and it’s not just the grill.
notes.content:
[b]On April 15th,[/b] the doors to your wrap shop swing open for the very first time. Wrap House Simulator: Prologue is almost here — and you’re about to find out what it really means to run a kitchen that never sleeps.

[h3]But listen — this isn’t just a taste test.[/h3]
We want to hear the sizzle and the crackle from you. Whether you’re a wrap-slinging machine or your station’s on fire (literally), your feedback and ideas will help shape what comes next.

💬 Play. Experiment. Burn things (intentionally or not).
 Then jump into the discussion and let us know:
 – What made you hungry for more?
 – What needs more salt?
 – What if there was a burrito boss fight?

This prologue is just the first bite. We’re building something big, and you’re at the counter with us.
🧑‍🍳 Get ready to chop, grill, wrap… and survive. [b]Together in coop[/b].

[h3][b]Wishlist the prologue[/b] if you haven’t already — and we’ll see you in the kitchen soon.
 15.04 – apron on, let’s go.[/h3]

notes.title: Demo Update - 07 April - Wrap Tagging Bugfixed & Sneakpeek
notes.content:
Hey [b]Wrappers![/b] 🌯

We’re super excited to announce that the long-standing [b]wrap tagging bug[/b] has finally been fixed! 🎉

This bug has been one of the most reported issues since the demo dropped—players getting stuck during the tagging process with no way to continue.

After weeks of trying to reproduce it (and failing), we finally cracked it. The culprit?

A sneaky localization issue that prevented the game from recognizing when the player wanted to exit the tagging state. It’s now fully resolved!

Huge thanks to everyone who kept reporting it and helping us narrow it down.

This was a tough one, and we’re so relieved to finally say it’s gone for good. 🙌

🎁 [b]As a thank-you, here’s a sneak peek![/b]

We’ve been hard at work on the full version of the game—and it’s starting to come together!
To celebrate this milestone and thank you for all the support, here’s a little screenshot straight from our current development build:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506132/a5fba70038fe023499432c5642982e8f2cbfc82d.png[/img]

[b]We hope you're as excited as we are. More updates coming soon! [/b]❤️

notes.title: Demo Patch Note - Feb 25
notes.content:
Hello Wrappers !

We're thrilled to be part of Steam Next Fest, and we’ve been working hard to smooth out your experience with various fixes and improvements. Thanks for all your feedback! Here’s what’s changed in this update:

Bug Fixes
✅ Fixed an issue where the day-ending sofa remained constantly highlighted.
✅ Customers will no longer get stuck while leaving due to trays on tables.
✅ Customers now properly despawn after a day reset.
✅ Ketchup and Mayo filling key indicator is now correctly displayed as "E" instead of "LMB."
✅ Items no longer disappear when releasing "E" after holding it.
✅ Fixed various collision issues for a smoother experience.
✅ Character’s body no longer clips through clothing while using emotes.
✅ Several visual bugs have been resolved.
✅ Fixed a rare bug that prevented players from letting go of the computer.
✅ Players can now properly retrieve cut doner from the station using the shovel when the doner is finished.
✅ Players who join after the game has started will now see the correct amount of items in the package.
✅ Game icon not being properly displayed has been resolved.

Gameplay Adjustments
🔧 Adjusted customer frequency to improve gameplay balance.
🧊 Raw Doners can now be saved by placing them in the freezer room.
🔊 Sound adjustments for a more immersive and enjoyable experience.

The update will soon be live!
We hope you enjoy the improvements! Keep the feedback coming, and let us know if you encounter anything else. See you in the kitchen! 🍽️🔥
